# Godscar GitHub Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) and [START-HERE.md](../../START-HERE.md). This default branch is NOT the active product. Go to `preview/browser` and read its complete handoff before editing source. The accepted product is Claude's original continuous idle-combat browser game, not the incomplete Godot conversion.

Never blindly redesign or port frameworks. Clarify ambiguous major design; challenge risky ideas; write code humans can maintain. With every code change, update project state and changelog in the same commit, run tests and report actual GitHub/preview status. Do not touch Arcana.
